title: fix(plugin-detail): record:details read mode shows a textarea value with its line breaks (objectui#11577)
body:
Fixes #11577

Clause-②: no

## What changed

`record:details` read mode now draws a `textarea` value through the fields package's own read display: the `readonly` branch of `TextAreaField`, the display the record form shows a read-only textarea with. This is the read-mode half of objectui#11562, which routed edit mode to the same widget's editor.

- `DetailSection` is the one read path the `record:details` body draws a value through. A row whose resolved renderer type is `textarea` now renders `TextAreaField` with `readonly`, ahead of the `getCellRenderer` lookup. Every other type keeps its cell renderer, unchanged.
- The value is handed over as `String(coerceToSafeValue(value))`, the exact text `TextCellRenderer` drew. A string passes byte for byte; a non-string value reads as it did before instead of reaching React as an object.
- No second hand-written `whitespace-pre-wrap` copy in `plugin-detail`: the widget owns its read display. `TextAreaField` is already exported from `@object-ui/fields` and already imported by this package (the inline editor), so no package index export moves and `TextAreaField.tsx` is untouched.
- The fields package's cell-renderer table still maps `textarea` to `TextCellRenderer`. That is the grid cell, where one line is the intended shape, so grids are unchanged.

## Why

The read row resolved `textarea` through `getCellRenderer`, whose standard table maps it to `TextCellRenderer`: a one-line `truncate` cell (white-space `nowrap` plus an ellipsis). A stored note with a blank line and a trailing newline read as one line on the record page, while the record form's read-only field and, since objectui#11562, the inline editor both kept the breaks.

## Evidence

### Real browser, Chromium

The console dev server served a scratch page (untracked, deleted after the run) that mounts the real `RecordDetailView` with a stub data source. Object `showcase_task` declares `notes` and `short_note` as `textarea` and `remark` as `text`; `notes` and `remark` hold the same multi-line value. Read: the value cell's `innerText`, and the computed `white-space` of the element that draws it. The before leg is the ablation below (the old read path), served by the same dev server. Desktop (1280 px) and mobile (375 px) read identically.

| Row | before (old read path) | after (this PR) |
|---|---|---|
| Notes, `textarea`, multi-line | `"Call back Monday. Budget approved, needs legal review."`, `nowrap` | `"Call back Monday.\n\nBudget approved, needs legal review.\n"`, `pre-wrap` |
| Short Note, `textarea`, one line | `"Call back Monday."`, `nowrap` | `"Call back Monday."`, `pre-wrap` |
| Remark, `text`, multi-line (control) | `"Call back Monday. Budget approved, needs legal review."`, `nowrap` | same as before |

The before reading of Notes is the card's reported reading, character for character.

### Pins

`packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/__tests__/record-details.textareaReadDisplay-11577.test.tsx` mounts the real `RecordDetailsRenderer` with bare field names, so each row's type is the one the bound object declares, read through a data-source double as a running app reads it. Desktop and mobile each:

- a multi-line value: the value cell's markup equals what `TextAreaField` renders read-only for that value, on its own;
- the same value keeps its breaks: the drawn text equals the stored value byte for byte, and no element between it and the row carries `truncate`, `whitespace-nowrap` or `whitespace-normal`;
- CONTROL: a single-line value reads back as the same single line (green on both sides of the fix).

Plus two controls: `text` still renders `TextCellRenderer`'s markup for a multi-line value, and `email` still renders `EmailCellRenderer`'s (which also shows the declared types reached the rows).

- Green at `897bd53`: 8 passed (8).
- Red leg (ablation, `node ../objectstack/scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, wrapped in a shell trap that restores from `HEAD`): anchor `if (resolvedType === 'textarea') {` replaced by a type no field has, anchor count 1 to 0, blob `a9dc7b51` to `3699ca2e`. Result: 4 failed, 4 passed. The four reds are the two multi-line pins on desktop and on mobile; the single-line control and the `text` and `email` controls stay green. Restore: blob `a9dc7b51` equals `HEAD`'s, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- A first red run on base `2e818d0`, before the single-line control was narrowed to assert text only, read 6 failed, 2 passed.

### Gates

Local runs, all at `897bd53` (the final commit) unless named. Verify-lock runs give their `VERDICT` line.

- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/plugin-detail/` (whole package, at `f535ade`; `DetailSection.tsx` is byte-identical since): Test Files 234 passed, 1 skipped (235); Tests 2321 passed, 8 skipped (2329); `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- 73 test files outside the package, selected by import of `@object-ui/plugin-detail` or the detail renderers and by source-text read of `plugin-detail` paths: Test Files 73 passed (73); Tests 2726 passed (2726); `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter "@object-ui/plugin-detail^..." build`: exit 0. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-detail type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0. The test project lists the new pin (`--listFiles`, 1 hit) and compiles at `897bd53`.
- exit 0 each: `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new citations), `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:self-import`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:i18n-keys`, and `scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` (2 source files of 1 released package changed, 1 changeset declared), `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-type-check-coverage`.
- ESLint, narrowed to the 2 changed TypeScript files. The population is the root `eslint.config.js`: the package has no config of its own, and its `eslint .` resolves the root one. The file count is 2, read from `--format json`. Both files report 0 errors. The test file has 0 warnings. `DetailSection.tsx` has 12 warnings, all on lines outside this diff's hunks. Invariance: the config enables no type-aware linting (zero hits for `projectService`, `parserOptions` or `TypeChecked`), so this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` belongs to CI.

## Acceptance notes

- **The single-line pin, as read here.** The ruling's "a single-line value is unchanged" is held as "reads back as the same text", which is pinned and green on both sides. The cell itself moves to the read display, so a long single-line value now wraps at the column width instead of ending in an ellipsis, as the record form's read-only field already does.
- **Mobile type size.** `TextAreaField`'s read block carries `text-sm`, so on the mobile grouped-inset row a `textarea` value draws at `text-sm` where the row's span sets 15 px. Left as is: changing it means editing `TextAreaField` beyond reaching its read branch, or a per-surface class, which is the second copy the ruling refuses. Observation only.
- **A host override of the `textarea` cell renderer** (`registerFieldRenderer` with `'textarea'`) would no longer reach this row, because the routing comes before `getCellRenderer`. Measured producers: zero. `git grep` for that call with `textarea` returns 0 hits; the same search for `lookup` returns 2.
- **The highlights strip** (`HeaderHighlight`, `record:highlights`) still draws a `textarea` value through `TextCellRenderer`, as one line with an ellipsis. Not this card's surface (the card names `record:details`), and the strip is a compact chip band. Observation, not filed.
- **Docs.** No page under `content/docs` or the package README describes how the details body reads a `textarea`, so no docs change is needed.

## Not touched

`TextAreaField.tsx`, the `@object-ui/fields` and `@object-ui/plugin-detail` package indexes, the grid's cell-renderer table, and the `markdown` / `html` read paths.

Implemented by the dispatched dev run in session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01FjqrwXPfSMkSfkKYDSRkN2`, on claim branch `claude/issue-11577-textarea-read-breaks`.
